mapper.insert: insert into stock_watchlist (user_id, ts_code, name, industry, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{tsCode}, #{name}, #{industry}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: delete from stock_watchlist where user_id = #{userId} and ts_code = #{tsCode}
mapper.select: select count(1) from stock_watchlist where user_id = #{userId}
select ts_code from stock_watchlist where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc
